description: "The self-executing engine-building chain for any Therantai session. Discriminates input type (bare theme vs loaded fragments), routes to the correct spine-forging organ, enforces assay as a mandatory non-skippable gate, loads the full build contract, then enters the build. Claude drives the chain; assay failure routes back to the forge organ with the named re-entry constraint — it cannot route forward. The practitioner never names the next stage. Invoke with /forge-pipe, 'build an engine', 'I have a theme', 'forge an engine', 'I want to build something', 'spine then build', or any phrase signaling intent to move from idea to engine. Voice-tolerant — loose trigger matching."
